children: Needham reiterated their Buy rating on GSI Technology's stock with a price target of $9.00.
The price target implies an upside of 119.0% from the Oct 21 close of $4.11.
Key takeaways from the analyst note

: GSI Technology has made significant advancements with its Gemini-II APU platform, successfully transitioning it into live operation and meeting key performance metrics, including a 90% detection accuracy and acceptable false alert levels. This progress not only validates their technology but also enhances their prospects in emerging markets.
Sustained Revenue from SRAM and New Opportunities

: Despite anticipated declines in traditional SRAM revenue, GSI Technology is expected to maintain stable core sales while ramping up new Rad-Hard devices. This dual approach positions the company well to offset declines and potentially generate $10-15 million in high-margin incremental annual revenue within the next few years, supporting a positive outlook.
